risk.A0: current decoded sender-frame red-component apparent proximity

physical_labels.near: no collision and episode minimum clearance <= 0.12 m
physical_labels.safe: no collision and episode minimum clearance > 0.12 m

development_success.mechanism: offline gate passes; at least 2 safety-value adaptive spends; at least 1 priority-1 spend; distractor has no safety-value spend; narrow passage has at least 1 safety-value spend; deadline plus fallback is at most 75 percent of adaptive episodes
development_success.predictive_value: A1 arms earlier than A0 in at least 2 paired cells and has at least 1 earlier safety-value spend or safety-value spend where A0 uses deadline/fallback
development_success.safety_path_1: A1 has at least 1 fewer near+collision episode than both A0 and U0, median minimum clearance is no more than 0.005 m worse than either, and task successes are at most 1 below the best comparator
development_success.safety_path_2: A1 near+collision is no worse than both, median and suite-minimum clearance each exceed both by at least 0.01 m, and task successes are at most 1 below the best comparator
development_success.classification: D if mechanism fails; A if mechanism, predictive value, and either safety path pass; B if mechanism passes, predictive value fails, and A0/A1 are safety-tied; otherwise C

selection_boundary: Frozen from Q1 signal semantics, Q1 neutral support, Q1 planner diagnostics, the existing CVC risk threshold, and one planner-horizon deadline before Q2 policy outcomes. No post-outcome retuning.
